description: REEF3D::SEASTATE static mesh refinement (G 1 2, REEFAMR): 30 x 15 cells of 200 m, slope 30 -> 6 m with a Gaussian island from the bathymetry raster (A 790 1, all grids), refinement by depth (A 791), coastline (A 792), bathymetry gradient (A 793) and a box (G 10), no refinement next to the boundary side (A 794); stationary composite solve with whitecapping, breaking with the SWAN maximum energy (A 737), triads with SWAN 41.31 parameters (A 736), SWAN-type convergence (A 709); handover points on the patches. Validation in Dropbox SEASTATE/validation/19-23.
covers: composite block Gauss-Seidel over the levels (fills, restriction, face spectra)
